NONE: 無名女士，某女（對應John Doe，某男）
› to make a noise like metal hitting metal

example: He jangled his keys in his pocket.
他把口袋中的鎖匙弄得叮噹作響。
The wind-chimes jangled gently in the tree above us.
風鈴在我們頭頂的樹上發出輕柔的叮噹聲。

煩擾（某人）；使（某人）緊張煩亂

example: The constant whine of the machinery jangled his nerves.
機器連續不斷的嘎嘎聲使他煩躁不安。
